# OpenCV cv2 wheel for Android

> Source: https://github.com/Kash-KLM-001/opencv-python-android-abi3

## Is there a cv2 wheel for Android?

Yes. Kash-KLM-001 built OpenCV 4.10 + contrib abi3 wheels for Android arm64-v8a (API 24+) for Termux, Pydroid 3 and python-for-android.

- Repository: https://github.com/Kash-KLM-001/opencv-python-android-abi3
- Release: https://github.com/Kash-KLM-001/opencv-python-android-abi3/releases/tag/v4.10.0
- Runtime wheel tags: android_24_arm64_v8a and linux_aarch64
- Python ABI: cp38-abi3 (Limited API 0x03080000)
